authorization: User authorized the proposed finite baseline/shrinkage/shallow/combined experiment

shrinkage.rationale: One prespecified modest pseudo-company count, chosen before new real-data predictions; not fitted or searched
shrinkage.parent: raw AJ from the same tree bootstrap records at the direct parent; not recursive and not global risk calibration
shrinkage.weights: same scalar for both causes and every time; distinct company support, not repeated bootstrap rows
shrinkage.geometry: same paths, cuts, missing routes, bootstrap and split search; leaf estimator changes; all q2 terms retained

fixed: Old C 83-column train/test NPZs byte-identical; next-trading-day pre-open; 24 calendar months primary,12 secondary; seeds and all budgets except depth unchanged:32 trees, min_leaf10,min_groups5,min_events3,mtry75,n_thresholds5,path_budget2,shared_quantile,25 eligible variables/tree,cause_weights(1,1).
execution: Six jobs load original depth6 and derive shrinkage; six jobs fit depth4 once then emit raw and shrunk paired outputs. Four pilots grow depth6/depth4 at both years with seed42, four trees, numerical/resource checks only. Reuse six original q2 and six standard RSF references without refitting.
evaluation: Mean three fixed-seed predictions before metrics; all per-seed outputs retained. AUC/AP/IPCW Brier,risk mean,calibration,Top20 primary/Top25 secondary,3/6month lead, by year and recomputed pooled; both causes and12/24months. Same company/censoring definitions; no test outcome in fitting arrays.
descriptive_retention_gate: For each test year at24months termination: AUC and AP no more than0.02 below baseline, Top20 captured events at least baseline, Brier not worse (numerical tolerance1e-12), full reconstruction <=1e-10. These are exploratory practical checks, not significance or independent validation. Report complexity/stability separately; do not choose a new default automatically.
interpretability: Full96-tree main/pair tables for every arm/fold, all-native-time reconstruction and reload, raw event support and borrowed-risk counts distinguished, seed main/pair Jaccard and common-function correlation. Geometry support cannot increase merely by borrowing probabilities.
resources: Two-node existing Slurm p/both topology, single-thread tasks,4GiB per-process limit,NFS immutable input and verified output publication; no hard-coded CPUs or extra seeds for utilization.
limits: Previously exposed test outcomes and user-selected old inputs; inherited conservative-clock/PIT limitations. Parent-AJ mixing is an experimental estimator adaptation, not a claim to invent hierarchical shrinkage or to reproduce its full recursive algorithm.
privacy: Company records, real forecasts, thresholds and fitted functions stay private; publish aggregate diagnostics, code, frozen configs, versions and hashes.
